0.original: Maru has a crease of consternation upon his noble brow.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

48.original: One of our new recruits has been takin' his sweet time with his delivery...

49.original: He ain't irresponsible, just...not the best conversationalist. You think you could check in on him an' make sure he's alright?

50.original: He's probably loiterin' nervously around the Great Work somewhere. Give him a nudge in the right direction if he ain't makin' progress.

51.original: B-By the Sisters! This man just snuck up on me and started shouting! What does he want? I'm terrified to ask!

52.original: This man has been standing here, squirming in silence for some time. Is he in distress?

54.original: S-Stop shouting at me! Just tell me what you want and leave me be!

55.original: N-No, I didn't mean─! Th-The boss always says to s-speak up, so I just─! Er!

57.original: Pause. Now take a deep breath.

58.original: You must speak confidently, man! From your diaphragm!

59.original: Eye contact is key. Steady, unblinking eye contact...

61.original: After several uncomfortable moments, it becomes clear that this method isn't working. Try advising him again.

62.original: D-Deep breaths? O-Okay... That... Oh, that feels better... Whooo...

63.original: I think I can take it from here, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>! Thanks for your help─an' tell Maru that I'll be back soon!

65.original: He appears to be in deep thought, but I'm not certain why he wishes I bear witness to it...

66.original: I-I knew what I was gonna say... But now I can't remember nothin'... Er...

68.original: Have you a written list of your objectives?

69.original: Remember, man! Remember with sheer willpower!

70.original: Just start talking until you figure it out.

72.original: After several uncomfortable moments, it becomes clear that this method isn't working. Try advising him again.

73.original: Oh, th-that's right! I wrote it down, didn't I? 'Cause I knew somethin' like this might happen! Ha! I got so nervous, I even forgot that I remembered that I'd forget!

74.original: Thanks, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>─I think I'll be alright! Tell Maru that I'll be back soon.

75.original: I remember their name... But what did they look like again...? Oh no...

77.original: I'm sure Nidhana could point you in the right direction.

78.original: Just introduce yourself to everybody here. You're bound to remember at some point!

79.original: Start screaming their name. I'm sure <hex:021A020203>someone<hex:021A020103> will come running.

80.original: I-If I could do that, I would've done it already!

81.original: The nervous Rider's shoulders slump dejectedly. Try advising him again.

82.original: O-Oh! I was so focused on tryin' to fix it myself, I never considered askin' for help!

83.original: Thanks, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>! I can take it from here. Tell Maru not to worry no more!

84.original: So that's what he was up to... Thanks for steerin' him true.

85.original: His nerves can really get the better of him, but he's been downright stubborn about helpin' out with deliveries.

86.original: We'll keep him runnin' errands closer to home, but I hope you won't be averse to helpin' him out again, should he need it. I know it'd mean the world to him...
